offering_description.value: Emergent BioSolutions develops and manufactures medical countermeasures for government stockpiles and healthcare providers. It also sells over-the-counter naloxone nasal spray for opioid overdose reversal through pharmacies and other retailers.

primary_products.value: Anthrax vaccines and antitoxins; smallpox vaccines and treatments; naloxone nasal spray; botulism antitoxin

quotes.quote: We leverage our specialized in-house capabilities to support biopharma innovators, governments and non-government organizations with their development and manufacturing needs. ​

customer_segment.value: B2G: Government stockpile and public health agencies, military procurement organizations; B2B: Pharmaceutical wholesalers, pharmacy chains, hospitals and nonprofit harm reduction organizations; B2C: Individuals and caregivers buying over-the-counter naloxone

end_markets.value: Public health and biodefense preparedness; opioid overdose prevention and response; emergency medicine; consumer pharmacy

revenue_model.value: product sales: Vaccines and therapeutics for government stockpiles, plus naloxone sold to institutional and retail buyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Develops and manufactures vaccines and therapeutics for government agencies, healthcare institutions and pharmacy supply chains

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada, with medical countermeasure sales to governments in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: Biodefense vaccines and therapeutics, plus opioid overdose reversal medicines

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Government procurement contracts and direct institutional purchasing; distributors / dealers: Pharmaceutical wholesalers supplying pharmacies and healthcare institutions; third-party retail: Pharmacies and other retailers selling over-the-counter naloxone
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Vaccines and drugs require FDA or equivalent approvals and must meet pharmaceutical manufacturing standards

notes: The current scope of any remaining contract manufacturing services is uncertain following facility divestitures.
